title: Upper amplitude from the coefficient-relative proper heart bound
statement: Fix universes u and u+1, a prime ell, a field k in Type u of positive prime characteristic different from ell, separated finite-type k-schemes Z and Y, and a proper k-morphism g:Z to Y. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring certified by IsEllAdicCoefficient [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. In the ordinary internal Lambda_Z-module derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], put P=ind(IsConstructibleModuleObject Lambda_Z) [def-sfb-constructible-module]. There exists c in Nat such that for every integer b and every complex K with all cohomology objects in P and H^i(K)=0 for i>b, the ordinary derived image Rg_*K has H^i=0 for i>b+c. No lower bound on K is assumed.

source.place: Intermediate step of the proper truncation-tail argument

proof.text: Transport exact countable products across the internal-module/section-module equivalence on Z and Y. Derived pushforward is triangulated and preserves countable products by its right adjunction. Construct the zero module presentation directly and use its membership in the coefficient-relative ind heart to make its homology property stable under truncation.

Take the uniform heart bound c0. Shift compatibility bounds a heart object placed in degree n by n+c0. Induct on the finite cohomology interval: the lower truncation has a shorter interval and the upper truncation is its top cohomology object placed in that degree. The image triangle preserves the bound, so each lower truncation tau_ge(-n)K has image at most b+c0.

Reconstruct K with its canonical Postnikov Roos triangle. Exact countable products commute with target homology, and the right adjoint preserves the source product. Both product terms of the image triangle are therefore at most b+c0. For j>b+c0+1, the vanishing in degrees j-1 and j of those terms forces H^j(Rg_*K)=0. Choose c=c0+1. This uses no stabilization or sharp heart-to-complex upper-bound theorem.

proof_origin.place: D4: finite truncation induction and the one-degree Roos-triangle bound; the existential constant is enlarged by one.

      (K : DerivedCategory

      DerivedCategory.homologyProperty (ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left))) K → K.IsLE b →
